summary.headline: Thunder Omens by Zodiac Sign
summary.text: Astrological and meteorological omens associated with thunder in Cancer, Leo, Virgo, and Libra, and with eclipses, mist, earthquakes, and unusual sounds or waters. The predictions concern famine, crop and livestock destruction, disease, deaths of rulers and notable men, warfare, captures, and disturbances across May through August.
